decisions.rationale: Initial exploration across major sites s1, s4, and s5 to identify strong baseline impacts on f1 and f2 compared to the default point.
Config 2 achieved very low f1 with s1=A, s2=A, s3=B, s4=A. Exploring variations around s1=A, s4=A and testing s5/s6 choices to balance low f1 while reducing f2.
s1=A and s4=A yield the best trade-offs. Testing combinations of s2=A (which sharply reduces f1) with s5=D (which yields the lowest f2=5824), and exploring s5=E with s1=A.
s1=A, s3=B, s4=A yields strong results. Combining s2=B (minimizing f2 to 5824) with s5=E should yield lower f1 at minimal f2, while testing s2=B with s6=B explores the trade-off.
s1=A, s4=A, s3=B with s2=A gives lower f1 while s2=B optimizes f2 (5824). Exploring combinations with s5=C/E and s6=A/B across varying s2 or s1=C to discover favorable trade-offs.
Exploring s1=D and s1=B with s4=A and s6=A/B to test if they offer improved lower f1 or competitive low f2 trade-offs against s1=A and s1=C.
Testing s1=C with various s5/s4/s6 configurations and exploring s1=B with s3=A to balance low f1 and low f2 near the Pareto frontier.
Evaluating s1=C with s5=D/A exploring f2-minimizing region, and testing s1=E configurations with optimal downstream labels (s4=A, s6=B) to complete trade-off boundaries.
s1=E with s2=B, s4=A achieves low f2 (5696); testing s5 variants (C, D) and s3=A for s1=E could reduce f2 further. Also testing s1=C with s5=D/C to explore trade-offs.
Testing s4=C and s4=D on low-f2 base configurations, and exploring s1=E with s2=A to see if f2 reaches lower thresholds while keeping f1 moderate.
Investigate s1=E with s2=A, s3=B, s4=A and s5=C,A under s6=A to capture the intermediate trade-off between f2=5632 and f2=9600; also test s1=E with s5=D.
Evaluating unexplored s1=B,D,C with s4=A and s5=D/E combinations, specifically probing s1=B with s2=B,s3=B to compete with low f2, and testing s1=D for lowest f1.
s1=E achieves the lowest f2 values with s2=B, s4=A, s6=A, while s1=B or D minimizes f1 with s6=B. Testing untested combinations of s4/s5 with s1=E and s1=B.
Explores unmeasured combinations targeting low f1 and low f2 Pareto gaps, particularly testing s1=B,C,D,E with s4=A and unvisited s5/s6 settings, and s1=C with s5=D.

Evaluating s1=E with s2=B, s3=A, and s5=C/E/D alongside s4=A and s6=B explores potential Pareto-improving f1 reductions while staying near optimal f2 levels; also testing s1=C with s5=D for lowest f1 in class.
Evaluating unexplored label combinations under promising s1, s2, and s4=A settings, testing s4 variants and s1=D/B interactions to push Pareto boundary.
Evaluate unexplored combinations of s1=C with s4=A and s6=B, as well as s4=B/D interactions on low-cost Pareto candidates.
Testing s4=E with optimal low-f1 patterns (s2=A, s3=B, s6=B) and exploring unvisited low-f2 configurations with s1=E, s2=B, s4=A, and s5 variants.
Focusing on s4=A which consistently yields superior Pareto trade-offs across s1, exploring unmeasured s5=B,D under high-performing s2=A/B and s3=B baselines.
Evaluating s1=A/B with s2=B, s3=A to discover extreme low-f2 points, and testing s1=C with s6=B or s1=D for potential non-dominated trade-offs near the middle front.
Explore diverse variants by altering unconstrained primary factors s1, s4, and s5 to identify strong main effects relative to the baseline.
Config 4 achieves very low f1 but high f2. Evaluating variants combining low-f1 features (s1=A/C, s2=A, s3=B, s4=B) with low-f2 features (s5=D, s6=A) to find balanced Pareto improvements.
Combining s1=C, s2=A, s3=B with s5=A and s6=A to test intermediate f1-f2 trade-offs, and exploring s1=A with s5=A and s4=D to exploit low f1 while keeping f2 near baseline.
s1=A combined with s6=B yields strong trade-offs. Evaluating untested s5 variations (E, B) and s4 labels with s1=A and s6=B to discover lower f1 while maintaining low f2.
s1=A combined with s6=B yields strong f1 improvements; testing s5=E, s5=B, and s5=D with other s4 labels to refine the low-f2, mid-f1 trade-off region.
s4=A yields massive f1 reductions (e.g. config 26). Testing s4=A with s5=E, s5=B, and s5=D across s1=A and s1=C probes promising non-dominated trade-offs between low f1 and modest f2.
Combine high-performing s4=A and s1=A/C configurations with s5=D/E/B and s6=A/B to push Pareto efficiency across low f1 and low f2 boundaries.
Targeting low f1 and low f2 by pairing s4=A with promising s5 values (B, D, E) across untested s1/s2/s3/s6 combinations.
Focus on high-performing s4=A with s2=A/s3=B combinations. Testing s1 variations (B, E) and s5=C on promising bases to bridge trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Testing s1=E,D,B combinations with s4=A and s5=B,D,E to explore low f1/f2 trade-offs between configs 35, 43, 44, and 46.
Test s1=E across promising combinations of s4=A and s5=C or s5=E with s6=A, exploring whether s1=E improves trade-offs over s1=C and s1=D near the Pareto frontier.
Evaluating s1=D with s2=B and s1=E with s5=C/s2=B explores low f2 regimes, while s1=B with s2=B tests unexplored tradeoffs on the lower f2 edge.
Testing s1=D with s5=C or s5=E under s2=B, s3=B, and testing s1=A with s5=A or s5=D to push the extreme low-f2 boundary (<5800) and fill low-f1 trade-offs.
Testing s3=A on s1=E/D with s2=B, s4=A to reach minimal f2 (as seen in #65 reaching 5632), alongside evaluating unexplored combinations with s5=D/E on the low-f2 boundary.
Testing s5=C with s1=D, s2=B, s3=A to potentially push minimal f2 below 5632, and evaluating s1=E, s2=B, s3=A with s5=C and s5=E along the low-f2 boundary.
Test s1=D, s2=B, s3=A with s4=A and s5=A/C/B, or explore missing combinations of s2=B with s6=B to uncover potential improvements in the low f2 frontier.
Evaluate s1=E, s2=A, s3=B with s5=A and s6=B, and explore s1=D with s5=A, s6=B to bridge the gap in low f1.
Testing s4=A with s2=B, s3=A to discover lower f2, and exploring s1=B variants around the high-performing s4=A region where f2 is low.
Test s1=C with s6=B across different s5 choices, and explore combinations of s3=B with s2=B at s4=A to find better trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Evaluating s1=A with s4=A and s6=B tests the low-f1 boundary where s1=A previously yielded low f2, and exploring s1=C with s2=B, s3=B, s5=D, s6=B probes trade-offs near the middle Pareto region.
Sample diverse values across s1, s4, and s5 relative to the baseline to evaluate sensitivity across dimensions.
s1=E achieved by far the lowest f1 cost, while s1=D has the lowest f2. Test variations combining s1=E with components from low f2/f1 configs (s4=E, s5=C, s5=B).
s1=E and s4=D yield the strongest Pareto candidates. Varying s5 (A, D) while keeping s1=E, s4=D tests if f1 or f2 improves beyond current front members.
s1=E with s4=D consistently yields the lowest f1 and f2. Testing s5=A and s5=B with s6=B explores lower f1 bounds, while s5=E with s6=A targets trade-offs near the best f2 frontier.
s1=E with s4=D provides the best trade-off front. Testing s5=A and s5=E with s6=A/B showed Pareto improvements; explore other s1 values or variations in s5 and s6 under s1=E.
Evaluating s1=C with various s5 options under s4=D to discover lower f2 values below 5760, and exploring other s4 options combined with the dominant s1=E configurations.
s1=E gives lowest f1, s4=D is optimal across f1 and f2. Test s3=B with other s1 options (s1=C, s2=B, s3=B) and unexplored interactions with s5/s6 to push f2 below 5760.
Investigate s3=B with s1=C and s2=A/B to balance f1 and f2, while testing s1=C with s5=E,A and s6=B to probe non-dominated tradeoffs.
s1=C with s2=A and s3=B sharply reduces f1; testing other s5/s6 variations under this combination may discover better trade-offs or further f1 improvements.
s1=C, s2=A, s3=B with s4=D produces dominant f1 values. Testing s5=D (which ignores s6) explores whether f1 can be minimized while improving f2 relative to s6=B.
Evaluate untested s1 variations and s4 settings under the highly promising combination (s2=A, s3=B, s5=E, s6=B/A) to discover lower f1/f2 trade-offs.
Testing s5=B on top of s1=B, s2=A, s3=B, s4=D, s6=B to seek lower f1, and exploring s3=B with s1=E/s2=B combinations for trade-offs.
Test s1=D with s5=D to achieve low f2 with competitive f1, and test s1=B with s5=D for improved tradeoffs.
Target lowest f2 regions where s1=D, s2=B, s4=D achieves minimal f2 (~5632), exploring untested s5 labels (A, C) and testing s3=B combinations to push the trade-off.
s1=D, s2=B, s4=D minimizes f2 (5632), while s1=B, s2=A, s3=B, s4=D minimizes f1. Exploring s1=D/C with s5=C/E to test low-f2 boundaries and intermediate trade-offs.
Test low f2 configurations with s2=B, s3=A/B, and check unexplored combinations for s1=D/C with f2-minimizing labels, plus explore s1=E across other sites.
Test s1=E with s3=B (if not ignored; s1=E ignores s2,s3) vs unexplored high-performing combinations like s1=A,B,C,D with s4=D under different s5/s6 settings targeting f1/f2 gaps.
Testing s1=D with s2=B, s3=B, and s5=A/E with s6=B or exploring s1=A/B with s2=B, s3=A to discover lower f2 or f1 tradeoffs.
Evaluating s1=E with s3=B or exploring s1=E variants with low f2, plus searching s1=D with s3=B on non-evaluated high-performing points.
Test s1=E with s3=B or variants where s1=E ignores s2/s3 to verify f1 minimization near the 140k/5.8k frontier, and explore unseen s1=B or s1=D combinations.
Initial exploration across primary categorical factors s1, s4, and s5 to identify strong main effects on f1 and f2 relative to baseline.
Combine low f1 from s4=A with low f2 features from config 1 (s5=B, s6=B, s1=D) to explore the optimal trade-off frontier between 77k and 382k.
s4=A consistently yields superior f1 and f2. Combining s4=A with s2=A and s3=B (which showed strong f1 in configs 2 and 6) with s5=B, s6=B aims to balance f1 minimization with low f2.
s1=A and s4=A strongly favor lower f1, while s2=B, s3=B or s5=A consistently optimize trade-offs between f1 and f2. We test combinations of s1=A/B with s3=B and s5=A.
s1=B and s4=A yield strong f1 and low f2. Exploring variations of s5 with s1=B, s4=A, and s2=B gives high potential for non-dominated trade-offs.
s1=B offers strong f1/f2 efficiency while s6=A drastically lowers f1 at cost to f2. Testing s1=B with s5 in {A, C, E} under s6=A and exploring s1=D variants to refine Pareto tradeoffs.
s1=B and s1=D achieve best f2 (with s6=B) and best f1 (with s6=A). Testing s1=B with s5=A and s6=A, plus s4=D/E, explores whether lower f1 can be attained at moderate f2.
s1=B and s4=A yield the lowest f1/f2 balance. While s6=A drastically drops f1, s5=A ignores s6. Testing s1=B, s4=A, s5=B, s6=A probes f1 reduction with lower f2 penalties.
Evaluating variations around s1=A, s2=A, s3=B with promising s5 values (D, E) to improve low-f1, alongside testing s6=A on s1=A to probe extreme low f1.
Evaluating variations around s1=A, s2=A, s3=B, s4=A and s6=A/B with s5=D/A to push the extreme low-f1 boundary and explore Pareto improvements.
Testing s2=A with s3=B on promising base configurations (s1=B and s1=D) to uncover extreme low f1 values, and testing s5=A combined with s1=A, s2=A, s3=B.
s1=E with s2=A, s3=B, s4=A, s5=C achieved the lowest f1 so far. Testing s6=B on s1=E could reduce f2 significantly, as seen in s1=D and s1=A.
s1=E with s2=A, s3=B, s4=A and s5=E,A achieved near-optimal f1; testing s5=E,A with s6=A/B explores the sharp low-f1 edge, while s1=D variants refine intermediate Pareto tradeoffs.
Evaluating s1=D, s2=A, s3=B with s5=A or s5=E, and s1=D, s2=A, s3=A to explore intermediate trade-off points between f1 and f2.
Testing s5=A with s2=A and s3=B across s1={A,D,E} where s6 is ignored, to search for extreme low f1 values, along with unexplored s1=B variants.
Test s1=E with s5=A and s6=A, and s1=D with s3=B, s5=A/C to uncover optimal combinations along the low f1 / low f2 frontier.

Explores promising untested combinations around the Pareto frontier, specifically examining s1=B with s3=B (if valid, though s2/s3 ignored) and targeting s1=E, D, A variants with optimal s4=A and varied s5/s6.
Testing s4=B/D/E on s1=B, and testing s4 variants with s1=D/B, seeking Pareto improvements in the 5600-6000 f2 range.
Testing s1=B with s4=A and s5=C/A/D vs other s4/s6 combinations, and examining unvisited combinations near the low-f2 / low-f1 boundaries.
We explore untested combinations of top Pareto sites (s1=E/A/D, s2=A, s3=B, s4=A) with s5=A or s5=C, and s1=B with s4=A and s5=B/C to discover better trade-offs in low f1 and f2 regions.
Initial exploration across major sites s1, s4, and s5 to identify strong main effects relative to the baseline.
s1=B dramatically drops f1 while s1=C and s5=A reduce f1 with minimal f2 increase. We explore s1=B and s1=C with baseline/f2-friendly settings (s5=A/D, s6=B) to find optimal trade-offs.
s1=C strongly reduces f1 without harming f2 excessively, while s4=C showed a huge f1 reduction in config 6. Combining s1=C with s4=C and varying s5 should explore optimal trade-offs.
Combine top low-f2 drivers (s1=C, s4=C) with variations of s5 (B, E) and test s4=E to discover better trade-offs around the lower f2 frontier.
Test s1=C with s4=C, s5=A, and s6=A to lower f1 while keeping f2 modest, and isolate s2/s3 under s1=B.
s1=B, s2=A, s3=B, s4=C achieved the lowest f1 values, especially when paired with s6=A or s5=C. Testing s5=A and s5=D with s6=A, plus exploring remaining s1=C frontiers.
Test untested labels at s4 and other s1 variants with s2=A,s3=B to probe lower f1, and test s1=A,D with s4=C to search for potentially lower f2 values.
Exploring s1=D and s1=E with s4=C to optimize f2, and testing whether s2/s3 interactions transfer to s1=D/A for lower f1-f2 combinations.
Testing s1=A and s1=D with s2=A, s3=B, s4=C, and s6=B to bridge the trade-off between ultra-low f1 and minimal f2, alongside exploring s1=C with s5=A/s6=B variants.
Evaluate s1=E with s2=A, s3=B, s4=C to check trade-offs; also test s1=A and s1=D with s5=C or s6=A for potentially lower f1/f2.
Evaluating s1=C with s5=B, s6=A/B and s1=A/D variants to trade between s2=A/s3=B low f1 and s1=C/D low f2 regions.
Evaluating s2=A with s3=A and s4=C to explore intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2, testing s1=A and s1=D where s2=A/s3=B showed strong performance.
Evaluating s1=B with s2=B, s3=A, s4=C to explore whether s1=B can reach lower f2 than s1=A/D when paired with s2=B, s3=A, and s5 in {A, D, B}.
Testing s2=B with s3=B across top f2 performers to find intermediate Pareto points between f2~5700 and f2~9600, while checking remaining s6=A combinations with s1=A,D.
Testing s5=B with s1={A,D,B} under s2=A, s3=B, s6=A, and s5=C on s3=B combinations to explore intermediate trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Explores the frontier by combining s2=B, s3=B with s6=A, testing if s6=A substantially reduces f1 while maintaining low f2, and checks unexplored s5 levels under s1=C.
Evaluating unexplored combinations around s1=C with optimal s4=C, and testing s3=B alongside low-f2 settings to potentially dominate current Pareto solutions.
Testing s4=C with s1=E/C/D under combinations likely to uncover non-dominated trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Testing s5=C and s5=B on the best low-f2 branches (D, s2=B, s3=B, s4=C) and Pareto-frontier gaps around f1~100k, f2~5700.
Targeting low f2 and balanced trade-offs: C-branch with s5=B, untested A/B configurations with low-cost parameters, and exploiting s1=D with s4=C, s5=D/A to find the minimum f2 boundary.
Sample diverse values across s1, s4, and s5 to explore baseline impact on both objectives and locate potential sensitivity gradients early in the search budget.
Combine high-performing s1=C and s5=A to reduce f1 while maintaining low f2, and explore remaining labels of s1 (D, E) and s4/s5 variations.
s1=C strongly reduces f1 while maintaining moderate f2. Exploring combinations of s1=C with various s5 values (C, E) and s4 options (C, D) to uncover deeper Pareto frontiers.
Evaluation 15 showed s4=E drastically improves both objectives. Testing s4=E across different s5 labels, as well as s6=B, to explore potential synergy with s1=C.
Evaluate combinations around s4=E and s5=D with s6=B, or alternative s1 values with s4=E to probe lower f1 and f2 trade-offs.
Evaluating s1=A and s1=E combined with s4=E and s5=A/B explores whether lower f2 values can be found without s1=C, while testing s2/s3 variants when s1!=C under s4=E.
s4=E strongly optimizes both objectives. Exploring s3=A and s2=B combined with s5=A/B and s1 in {A, B} targets the low-f1, low-to-moderate-f2 trade-off region.
Combine top choices (s4=E, s5=A/D, s3=A, s2=B) across s1 options (A, B, E) and test s6=B with s2=B to find non-dominated trade-offs.
Combine high-performing s2=B, s3=A, s4=E with s1=B or E across s5/s6 variations to push the low-f1 boundary and explore Pareto improvements.
Testing s1=D across high-performing s4=E configurations and investigating whether s1=D or alternate s5 settings can improve upon current Pareto-optimal points in f1 and f2.
Test s5=D with s6=B for s1 in {B, E} with s2=B, s3=A, s4=E to see if f2 improves over s5=A without sacrificing too much f1.
Evaluating s5=C on low-f1 setups (s1=B/E, s2=B, s3=A, s4=E) to check if f1 drops further, and testing s4 effects across unexplored combinations.
Evaluating s1=A with s2=B, s3=A, s4=E, s5=B, s6=B tests if s1=A can improve the low-f2 boundary around 11264, while s1=D variants or s1=A with s5=C explore remaining high-impact trade-offs.
Explores the low f2 region around s4=E with s3=A and s5=D/A across under-tested combinations, and investigates s1=C with s4=E, s5=D, s6=A which yielded f2=5824 previously.
Test s1=E with s2=B, s3=A, s4=E and s5=A/s6=B variants or examine unexplored low f2 settings like s1=A, s5=D with s3=A.
Test unexplored combinations of s1=C (which ignores s2/s3) and other promising sites with s4=E, specifically s5=E (previously dominated only by s5=D) and evaluate s3=A across untried branches.
Test s1=C with s4=E and s5=A/E across s6=A, and explore combinations of s3=A with s2=B for intermediate trade-offs not yet evaluated.
Evaluate s1=C with s4=E and s5=E, plus unexplored s1=B/E with s2=B, s3=A, s4=E, s5=E, s6=B to discover potential lower trade-offs.
Evaluating s1=A with s2=A, s3=B, s4=E, s5=E, and s1=A with s5=C or B combinations to explore lower f2 values alongside low f1.
Exploring s5=E with s1=B/E and s2=B, s3=A, s4=E to see if unconditioned s5=E reaches lower f1/f2 trade-offs.
Perform an initial exploratory sweep across diverse labels for major sites s1, s4, and s5 to establish baseline performance gradients across the design space.
s1=B yielded low f1 while s6=A/s5=A yield lower f2. Testing s1=B with s6=A, and variations combining low-f1 configurations with lower-f2 features to discover balanced Pareto points.
s1=B with s2=B, s3=B gives huge f1 reductions, while s5=C significantly lowers f1 further; testing variations with s6=A and differing s4/s5 to balance f2.
s1=D provides the best f2 (5824 in #15) with s4=B. Testing s1=D with s5=C or s5=E, and s1=B s2=B s3=B with alternative s5 values to optimize the f1-f2 trade-off.
s1=B with s2=B, s3=B, s4=B minimizes f1, while s6=B achieved f1=24916 in eval 3. Testing other s5 choices with s6=B, and testing s4=A for f1 gains.
Testing s1=D with s4=B and s6=B to see if f1 reduces like in s1=B while preserving low f2, and trying s5=D under Pareto-optimal patterns.
Testing s4=D under high-performing s1=B and s1=D backbones, alongside s4=B with s1=E/C variants, to explore missing trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Testing s1=E, s1=C, and s1=A with the high-performing s2=B, s3=B, s4=B configuration, and s1=D with s5=E, s6=B to uncover favorable trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Test low f1 configurations on C, A, and E with s5=E or s5=B, plus s6=A to discover lower f2 tradeoffs under the best s2/s3/s4 combinations.
Testing s1=C and s1=A with s2=B, s3=B, s4=B combined with s5=A or s5=B, aiming to discover lower f2 tradeoffs or non-dominated trade-offs in the 25k-73k f1 region.
Evaluating s1=A/C with s2=B, s3=B, s4=B and s5=D/B to find non-dominated points balancing f1 and f2, leveraging low f2 from s1=A/C combined with optimal s4=B.
Evaluating s1=E with s2=B, s3=B, s4=B to explore trade-offs near f2=9600-11264, plus s1=D variants to probe lower f2 boundaries.
Testing s1=E with s2=B, s3=B, s4=B to find lower f2 with moderate f1, plus exploring s1=C with s5=E, and probing s1=D variants.
Evaluating intermediate s2/s3 states or testing unexplored s4/s1 interactions with low-cost components (e.g., s2=B, s3=A or s2=A, s3=B with s4=B) to bridge the f1-f2 trade-off gap.
Evaluating s2=A s3=B combinations with s6=B and s5=C/E/B on s1=C and s1=A to probe intermediate low f1 and low f2 trade-offs.
Combine high-performing label s4=B with s1=B, s2=A, s3=B to find promising intermediate trade-offs between low f1 and low f2, testing combinations of s5 and s6 unexplored with this backbone.
Testing s1=A with s2=A, s3=B, s4=B, s5=A/D, s6=A, and s1=E variants targeting low f2 (~5824) with potentially lower f1 than D.
s1=E with s2=A, s3=B, s4=B yielded the new minimum f2 (5696). Testing other s5 variants with s1=E, s2=A, s3=B, s4=B could improve f2 further or optimize f1.
s1=E with s2=A, s3=B achieves minimum f2=5696. Exploring variations in s4 alongside Pareto-optimal frontiers could minimize f1 while preserving ultra-low f2.
Test s4=C with s1=E, s2=A, s3=B to probe whether f2 can be minimized further below 5696, and evaluate unexplored label combinations near the low-f1, low-f2 Pareto boundary.
Initial exploration across diverse parameter values to quickly identify high-impact labels for both objectives relative to the single baseline.
Combine label B for s1 and s4 with low-cost labels at other sites to balance f1 minimization while probing s2/s3/s5/s6 variations for lower f2.
s4=A strongly reduces f1 while s2=B, s6=B lower f2. Testing s1=B with s2=B, s3=A, s4=A and variations to find optimal trade-offs between f1 and f2.
s1=B, s3=A, s4=A yields strong Pareto points. Testing variations with s5=C/D and alternative s2 choices to bridge between low f1 and low f2 regions.
Evaluating s6=A on top-performing low-f1 configurations like #13, #18, and #16 to exploit the dramatic f1-reduction seen in #2 while maintaining relatively low f2.
Exploration around top Pareto candidates: s4=A, s3=A, and s6=B strongly reduce f2, while s5=B,C and s1=B,C yield lowest f1. Test s5=C with s6=A/B and s1=D/E interactions.
s1=D achieved strong f1 and low f2 in run 31 with s4=A and s5=B. Testing alternative s5 and s6 variants under s1=D to explore the Pareto front around f1~100k, f2~6k.
s1=D provides low f2 and moderate f1; testing other s5 variants with s4=A and s6=B. Also testing s1=A/B with s3=B to find lower f2 combinations, and s1=D with s5=E.
s1=D provides low f1 and very low f2 when s6=B. Testing remaining unexplored s5 levels (like s5=E canonicalised or variations) and s1=E configurations with s6=B to bridge Pareto frontiers.
s1=A and s3=B maximize f2 efficiency (f2=5632), while s5=C and s5=E have low f1/f2 overhead. Testing combinations of s1=A, s3=B, and s5=C/E to discover improved f2 boundary points.
Test s1=D with s5=E,A,B and s6=A to target low f1 with moderate f2, and check s1=B,C with s3=B,s5=E to improve f2.
Test s1=D with s5=E, s6=A where s6 is ignored; explore s1=E/A combinations to find non-dominated points between f1 and f2.
Testing s1=D with s5=E, s6=A to combine the lowest f1 branch under s1=D with low-cost components, and exploring unvisited combinations along the high-f2/low-f1 frontier.
Testing s1=D with s5=E and s6=A to combine low f1 from D/A combinations with potential pareto-improving cost, and evaluating unexplored s1/s4/s5 combinations at the low-f2 boundary.
Evaluating s1=D with s4=A and s5=E, s6=A tests whether s6=A can produce lower f1 with competitive f2. Testing s1=E with s2=B, s3=B, and s1=D with s3/s2 defaults checks frontier gaps.
Explores D with s5=E, s6=A/B variations and untested combinations under s1=D where s2 and s3 are ignored, targeting gaps between f1=95k and f1=141k along the Pareto frontier.
Evaluating s1=D with s5=E, s6=A to combine D's low f1 and potential lower f2, and exploring untested s1=E/A configurations with s6=A/B along the Pareto frontier.
Evaluating s1=D with s5=E and s6=A to test if s5=E achieves low f1 with lower f2 than other s1 labels, and testing unexplored combinations near the trade-off front.
Evaluating unexplored combinations targeting the low f1/f2 Pareto front, testing s1=D with s5=E on s6=A, and s1=A/C variants with s5=D or alternate s3/s4 settings.
Evaluating s1=D with s5=E and s6=A, as well as unexplored combinations of s2=A, s3=A with s4=A under untested s5 variants, targeting gaps in low f1 and balanced f2.
Test s1=E with s2=A, s3=A, s4=A, s5=D, s6=A to complete the low-f1 boundary exploration.
feedback: all proposed configurations are equivalent to already evaluated ones (s1=D s2=B s3=B s4=A s5=E s6=A); propose different ones

decisions.rationale: Explore major alternative values across s1, s4, and s5 relative to the baseline to observe sensitivity and discover orthogonal improvements.
s5=B strictly dominates original s5=C on f1 with equal f2, while s1=A and s1=C significantly reduce f1. We test combinations of s5=B with s1=A/C/D and explore untried s5=D/E values.
Combining top-performing values s5=D (best f1 at f2=6656) with s1=D, s1=C, and s1=A which strongly minimized f1, while exploring untested s1=E.
s1=E yields a dramatic ~48% reduction in f1. Testing other s5 values with s1=E, as well as checking s4 and s6 interactions, should explore potentially dominant points along the new frontier.
s1=E yields the best f1. Testing s4 and s5 variations with s6=A/B to balance lower f1 and f2.
s1=E and s4=E yield the lowest f1. Combining s4=E with s5=C or s6=A tests new trade-offs along the Pareto front. Also exploring s1=B with s4=E/C to see if f2 improves further.
Combine top performer s1=E and s4=E with untested s5 values and s6 choices (notably s5=E, s5=A) to find new non-dominated trade-offs along the Pareto frontier.
Focus on high-performing s1=E and s4=E. Test combinations with other s1 values (D, A) paired with s4=E and s5=C/E to discover low f2 points without extreme f1 penalties.
Test s2/s3 variants for s1=D with s4=E,s5=E,s6=B which achieved minimal f2=5760, and check if s1=C or other s1 labels yield lower f2 when paired with s4=E,s5=E.
With s1=D, s4=E, s5=E, setting s3=B drops f1 drastically while keeping f2 low (f2=5824). Combining s3=B with s1=A, s1=D variants or s5=C/D could establish new Pareto optima.
s2=B and s3=B drastically lower f1 on s1=A/D, while s6=A also reduces f1. Testing combinations with s6=A, s2=B, and s3=B explores high-performance frontiers.
Test s5=D with optimal parameters s2=B, s3=B, s4=E to find ultra-low f1 points, and explore s1=C with s2=B, s3=B and s1=A, s2=A, s3=B with s5=C.
Combining s2=B, s3=B, s4=E with s5=C or s5=A and s6=A may uncover new low-f1 trade-offs. Also evaluating s1=B with s2=B, s3=B, s4=E tests unexplored interactions.
Investigate s1=B with s2=B, s3=B, s4=E and varying s5 to discover improved f2-f1 trade-offs around f2=9600, plus s1=C to complete cross-label comparisons under optimal settings.
Testing s1=B with s3=B to find lower f2 frontiers, and checking s1=B with s5=C/B/A along s2=A,s3=B,s4=E,s6=B.
Explores the low f2 region around s1=B, s2=A, s3=A/B and s1=D with s5 variants or other untested combinations along the Pareto frontier.
Testing s5=A under extreme low-f1 conditions (s2=B, s3=B, s4=E) and checking if s1=B with s3=B, s6=A improves trade-offs near the 5600-9600 f2 frontier.
Exploration showed s1=B, s2=A, s3=A/B, s4=E achieves minimum f2, while s5=A or alternative s6 with s2=B, s3=B targets the extreme f1/f2 Pareto boundaries.
Exploit the Pareto frontier: test s5=A under low-f1 conditions (s2=B, s3=B, s4=E, s6=A/B) which often lowers f2, and check s5=E variations with s1=B,C to refine the trade-off.
Explores unmeasured configurations combining low-f1 features (s2=B, s3=B, s4=E) and low-f2 features (s5=A, s6=A/B), particularly testing s1=A and s1=D with s5=A and s6=A.
Initial exploration across major variables s1, s4, and s5 to identify sensitivity and primary cost reduction drivers relative to the baseline.

s1=C strongly reduced f1 without worsening f2 significantly. Combining s1=C with s5=A (which improved f1 at base f2) tests synergistic improvements. Exploring other s1 values (E) and s5 settings maps the front.
Combining s1=C and s4=B showed strong performance in config 8. We test combining s1=C, s4=B with favorable s5 levels (A, D) and explore s6 variations to push the Pareto front further.
Combine best sites: s1=C gives strong f1/f2 trade-offs; s4=B dramatically lowers f1; test unexplored s5 labels (B, E) and interaction of s5=D with s6=B.
Testing s5=E with s6=B alongside s1=C, s4=B to explore lower f1; also testing s1=D, s4=B with s5=C and s6=B, as well as s3/s2 effects on s1=D.
s1=D, s2=B, s3=B, s4=B with s6=A may balance extreme f1 reduction (from #23) with lower f2, while testing s5=C and s5=A.
Testing s1=D with s2=B, s3=B, and s4=B across unexplored s5 and s6 choices, alongside probing if s2=B with s3=B transfers effectively to other s1 backbones (A, B, E) for lower f2.
Test s1=A and s1=B with s2=B, s3=B, s4=B to find low f2 and low f1 trade-offs, while exploring s6=B for s1=A.
Evaluating s1=A with s2=B, s3=B, s4=B with other s5 choices (C, A, E) and s6=B, aiming to beat the Pareto frontier at low f1 and intermediate f2 values.
Evaluating s1=E with s2=B, s3=B, and s6=B tests if E provides lower f2 at the extreme low-f1 end, and testing s1=B with s5=C/A probes the intermediate front.
Test s2=A with s3=B on promising s1=A/B/E bases to explore intermediate trade-offs between low f1 and low f2, and test s1=B with s5=E/A for potential f2 advantages.
s1=B s2=A s3=B s4=B s5=D s6=A achieved minimal f2=5696. Testing s5 variations (B, C) with s1=B, s2=A, s3=B, and testing s3=B on minimal f1 setups.
Testing s1=B, s2=A, s3=B with s5=E, and s1=D/E combinations to discover non-dominated trade-offs between ultra-low f2 (around 5696) and competitive f1 values.
Evaluate untested s1 variants with s2=A, s3=B, s4=B to improve f2, and explore s5=E for low f1 values.
Explores minimal f2 using s1=B, s2=A, s3=B with alternative s4 values (A, C, E) or tries other unexplored s4 variations with optimal s2=B, s3=B, s6=B for low f1.
Evaluate unexplored combinations of s1=C with s4=B to push f1 and f2 boundaries, and test s1=B with s2=A, s3=B under untested s5 levels.

Exploit the best f2 labels with s4=B and test unexplored trade-offs, particularly checking if combining s1=B, s2=A, s3=B with other s5 values or testing s1=C configurations can push lower f1 or f2 boundaries.
Test s1=B with s3=A to discover lower f2, and explore s1=D/E combinations with s2=B, s3=B, s6=B for extreme low f1.
Test s1=B, s2=A, s3=A, s4=B with s5=B to probe lowest f2 (5632 region), and s1=D, s2=B, s3=B, s4=B with alternative s5/s6 settings to push the extreme low f1 boundary.
Evaluating s1=D, s2=B, s3=B with s4=B and s5=B, s6=B tests the remaining unvisited extreme point combination for minimum f1, while exploring under-tested s1=C combinations across s5 options.
